e8242498a3e07f1501745616a6ae6434aae1f596.definition: A pit that collects water from a floor or a basement so that a pump can lift it.
e8242498a3e07f1501745616a6ae6434aae1f596.gloss: A pit that collects water from a floor or a basement so that a pump can lift it.

e8242498a3e07f1501745616a6ae6434aae1f596.definition: 床や地下にできた、水や廃液を集めるためのくぼみ。底にポンプを置き、集まった液を汲み出す。
e8242498a3e07f1501745616a6ae6434aae1f596.gloss: 床や地下の水を集め、ポンプで汲み出すためのピット。

e8242498a3e07f1501745616a6ae6434aae1f596.definition: 바닥이나 지하실에 고인 물을 모으는 구덩이이다. 보통 배수구가 막히거나 물이 넘칠 때 펌프로 물을 빼낸다.
e8242498a3e07f1501745616a6ae6434aae1f596.gloss: 바닥 물을 모아 펌프로 빼낼 수 있도록 만든 구덩이.

e8242498a3e07f1501745616a6ae6434aae1f596.definition: Cavidade ou caixa rebaixada que recebe a água de um piso ou porão, geralmente para permitir o bombeamento por uma bomba.
e8242498a3e07f1501745616a6ae6434aae1f596.gloss: Cavidade que coleta água do piso ou do subsolo para que uma bomba a bombeie.

e8242498a3e07f1501745616a6ae6434aae1f596.definition: Lubang yang menampung air dari lantai atau basement agar dapat dipompa.
e8242498a3e07f1501745616a6ae6434aae1f596.gloss: Lubang yang menampung air dari lantai atau basement agar dapat dipompa.

e8242498a3e07f1501745616a6ae6434aae1f596.definition: บ่อขนาดเล็กที่รองรับน้ำจากพื้นหรือห้องใต้ดิน และใช้รวบรวมน้ำให้ปั๊มสูบออกไปได้
e8242498a3e07f1501745616a6ae6434aae1f596.gloss: บ่อรองที่รองรับน้ำจากพื้นหรือห้องใต้ดินเพื่อให้ปั๊มสูบขึ้น

e8242498a3e07f1501745616a6ae6434aae1f596.definition: Zemin veya bodrum katındaki suyu toplayan, pompanın suyu kaldırmasını sağlayan çukur.
e8242498a3e07f1501745616a6ae6434aae1f596.gloss: Zemin veya bodrum katındaki suyu toplayan çukur.

e8242498a3e07f1501745616a6ae6434aae1f596.translation: Zemin dreni tıklandığında bodrumdaki sump çukuru dolar.
บ่อรองในห้องใต้ดินมีน้ำสะสมเมื่อท่อระบายน้ำจากพื้นอุดตัน
Bak penampung di basement terisi penuh saat saluran air lantai tersumbat.
A caixa de coleta no porão enche quando o ralo do piso obstrui.
바닥 배수구가 막히면 지하실의 집수정에 물이 찬다.
床の排水口が詰まったとき、地下のピットに水がたまっていた。

e856898b16ccb4b8947611b9e9a01d7bb3cb3efe.gloss: A quality whose absence ends the possibility, as opposed to one that only lowers the score.

e856898b16ccb4b8947611b9e9a01d7bb3cb3efe.definition: 어떤 사람의 해당 특성이 없으면 관계를 시작하거나 계속할 수 없게 되는 조건을 가리킨다. 매력이나 적합도를 조금 낮추는 단순한 선호 조건과는 구별된다.
e856898b16ccb4b8947611b9e9a01d7bb3cb3efe.gloss: 존재하지 않으면 관계나 선택 자체가 불가능해지는 조건.

e856898b16ccb4b8947611b9e9a01d7bb3cb3efe.definition: Característica que, quando falta, elimina a possibilidade do relacionamento, em vez de apenas torná-lo menos desejável.
e856898b16ccb4b8947611b9e9a01d7bb3cb3efe.gloss: Uma qualidade cuja ausência encerra a possibilidade, ao contrário de uma que apenas reduz a nota.

e856898b16ccb4b8947611b9e9a01d7bb3cb3efe.gloss: Sifat yang ketiadaannya langsung menutup kemungkinan hubungan.

e856898b16ccb4b8947611b9e9a01d7bb3cb3efe.gloss: คุณสมบัติที่ขาดไม่ได้ในการเลือกคู่ครอง

e856898b16ccb4b8947611b9e9a01d7bb3cb3efe.definition: Bir kişide bulunmadığında eşleşmeyi veya ilişkiyi tamamen sona erdiren özellik. Yalnızca uygunluğu azaltan tercihlerden ayrılır.
e856898b16ccb4b8947611b9e9a01d7bb3cb3efe.gloss: Var olmadığında ilişkinin devamını imkânsız kılan özellik.

A desonestidade foi o deal-breaker, e o resto eram apenas preferências.
정직하지 못한 사람은 관계를 끝내는 결정적인 조건이었지만, 다른 문제들은 단지 선호의 차이였다.

e856898b16ccb4b8947611b9e9a01d7bb3cb3efe.text: Dishonesty was the deal-breaker, and the rest were preferences.

e878c7972658dd3705c3472d42cbaf5e6d875a92.definition: Braking at the limit of grip by pressing and releasing the pedal before the wheel locks.
e878c7972658dd3705c3472d42cbaf5e6d875a92.gloss: Braking at the limit of grip by pressing and releasing the pedal before the wheel locks.

e878c7972658dd3705c3472d42cbaf5e6d875a92.definition: タイヤが路面を抓住できる限界の力でブレーキを踏む技術。ABSがない車両では、ペダルを踏んだり緩めたりして車輪のロックを防ぐ。
e878c7972658dd3705c3472d42cbaf5e6d875a92.gloss: タイヤのグリップの限界で、車輪がロックしないように brake 操作を制御すること。

e878c7972658dd3705c3472d42cbaf5e6d875a92.definition: 바퀴가 완전히 잠기기 직전의 최대 마찰력 한계에서 페달 압력을 조절하며 제동하는 방법. ABS가 없는 차량에서는 이 기술이 필요하다.
e878c7972658dd3705c3472d42cbaf5e6d875a92.gloss: 바퀴가 잠기지 않도록 페달을 밟고 놓으며 최대 마찰력으로 제동하는 방법.

e878c7972658dd3705c3472d42cbaf5e6d875a92.definition: Técnica de frenagem usada quando não há sistema ABS, na qual o motorista pressiona e solta o pedal para evitar que a roda trave. Exige controle e pode não ser adequada em emergências.
e878c7972658dd3705c3472d42cbaf5e6d875a92.gloss: Frenagem no limite da aderência, alternando a pressão do pedal para impedir o travamento da roda.

e878c7972658dd3705c3472d42cbaf5e6d875a92.definition: Teknik pengereman pada batas daya cengkeraman dengan menekan dan melepas pedal rem sebelum roda terkunci. Pada kendaraan tanpa ABS, teknik ini diperlukan untuk mencegah terkunci.
e878c7972658dd3705c3472d42cbaf5e6d875a92.gloss: Pengereman pada batas cengkeraman dengan menekan dan melepas pedal sebelum roda terkunci.

e878c7972658dd3705c3472d42cbaf5e6d875a92.definition: วิธีเบรกที่ใช้แรงดันใกล้ขีดจำกัดแรงยึดเกาะสูงสุด ผู้ขับขี่ต้องกดแล้วคลายแป้นเบรกเป็นจังหวะเพื่อไม่ให้ล้อล็อกหมุน
e878c7972658dd3705c3472d42cbaf5e6d875a92.gloss: การเบรกในระดับขีดจำกัดแรงยึดเกาะโดยกดแล้วคลายแป้นก่อนล้อล็อก

e878c7972658dd3705c3472d42cbaf5e6d875a92.definition: Fren pedalına basılıp bırakılarak tekerleğin kilitlenmeden tutunma sınırında frenlenmesidir. ABS olmayan araçlarda kullanılır.
e878c7972658dd3705c3472d42cbaf5e6d875a92.gloss: Tekerlek kilitlenmeden, tutunma sınırında fren yapmak.

e878c7972658dd3705c3472d42cbaf5e6d875a92.translation: ABS olmayan araçta sürücünün sınırda frenleme yapması gerekir.
หากรถไม่มีระบบ ABS ผู้ขับขี่ต้องใช้การเบรกที่ขีดจำกัดแรงยึดเกาะ
Tanpa ABS, pengemudi harus menggunakan pengereman ambang.
Sem o sistema ABS, o motorista precisa usar a frenagem no limite da aderência.
ABS가 없는 차량에서는 한계 제동 기법을 사용해야 한다.
ABSがない車では、极限ブレーキを巧みに使う必要がある。

e878c7972658dd3705c3472d42cbaf5e6d875a92.text: Without ABS the driver has to use threshold braking.
e878c7972658dd3705c3472d42cbaf5e6d875a92.translation: Không có ABS, người lái phải dùng phanh tới ngưỡng.

e894adf124d00d55fb06af3e96fe8e38301d445a.definition: Flashing repeatedly, like an indicator lamp.

e8be592dbbc8a057aa77f0aa86cbe401abc9292d.definition: To put a seed into the ground and look after it. Planting is a promise to come back.

e8be592dbbc8a057aa77f0aa86cbe401abc9292d.gloss: 種を地面に埋め、育って成長するのを見守ること。

Plantar é colocar uma semente na terra e acompanhar seu crescimento. A imagem também sugere um compromisso de cuidar e voltar para ver o resultado.
e8be592dbbc8a057aa77f0aa86cbe401abc9292d.gloss: Colocar uma semente no solo e cuidar dela até que se desenvolva.
